2D Textures (HighRes).Description: High-resolution 2D texture images to be reduced to max 800 x 800px for use in BIM model. Do not import high-res textures in BIM model.

2D Textures (LowRes).Description: Low-resolution (max 800 x 800px) 2D texture images for BIM models to avoid large library files. Stored in the project BIM library; use for quick visualisations or placeholders.

3D Models Objects.Description: Library of 3D model object files/components for use in project BIM models. Located in the BIM library; includes standard model components for consistency.

3D Visualisation Objects.Description: Collection of 3D model files used for visualisation and rendering purposes. Downloaded for visualisation only; do not integrate into the main BIM model.

3DS/Lumion File.Description: 3D scene file for visualisations (e.g., 3ds Max or Lumion format) used in project renders. Typically stored on the visualiser server; coordinate with the visualisation team for access or updates.

AI Generated visualisations.Description: Project visualisation images generated using AI tools or software. Bond Bryan internal imagery; use for concept presentations or design inspiration.

Acoustic Report.Description: Acoustic report provided by the acoustic consultant. External document; implement recommendations and coordinate with design details.

Additional Fees approved.Description: Documents evidencing approval of additional service fees beyond the original contract. Refer to Additional Fees letter and change control. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-900x 'Additional Fees approved'.

Additional Fees calculations.Description: Spreadsheets or documents calculating additional fees for extra services or scope changes. Refer to Additional Fees letter and change control. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-L-A-900x 'Additional Fees calculations'.

Additional Fees letter.Description: Letter correspondence regarding the agreement or proposal of additional fees. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-900x 'Additional Fees letter'.

Agenda (BB Produced).Description: Meeting agenda document created by Bond Bryan for project meetings. Internal version of the agenda; compare with any incoming agendas from external parties.

Agenda (Incoming).Description: Meeting agenda document received from an external party or consultant.

Areas Schedules.Description: Area schedules (GIA/NIA etc.) produced from the BIM model. Series range 0000-0099. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-L-A-0000-0099 'Areas Schedules'.

Audio Recording.Description: Audio file recorded for project purposes (e.g., meeting, interview, or site walkthrough). Internal audio record; transcribe or note key points for project documentation. does not replace meeting minutes.

BIM BEP (draft BB produced).Description: Draft Building Information Modelling (BIM) Execution Plan produced by Bond Bryan. Internal draft version; review alongside the external draft and update for the final issue. Final version (agreed) in 0-ProjectGovernance/ContractualAndLegal.

BIM BEP (draft external).Description: Draft BIM Execution Plan document provided by an external consultant or party. External draft; coordinate with Bond Bryan's draft to prepare the final agreed BEP. Final version (agreed) in 0-ProjectGovernance/ContractualAndLegal.

BIM BEP (final).Description: Final Building Information Modelling (BIM) Execution Plan for the project. Official agreed version; supersedes all prior drafts and guides the project's BIM processes. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-900x 'BIM BEP (final)'.

BIM Clash Rendition (BCF).Description: BIM clash issues file in BCF (BIM Collaboration Format) capturing model coordination problems. Use it to track and resolve clashes with other disciplines.

BIM Project Protocol Standard (draft BB.Description: Draft project BIM protocol standard document prepared by Bond Bryan. Final version (agreed) in 0-ProjectGovernance/ContractualAndLegal.

BIM Project Protocol Standard (draft ext.Description: Draft project BIM protocol standard document provided by an external party. Final version (agreed) in 0-ProjectGovernance/ContractualAndLegal.

BIM Project Protocol Standard (final).Description: Final project BIM protocol standard outlining agreed BIM procedures and standards. Official approved protocol; all team members should adhere to this final version. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-900x 'BIM Project Protocol Standard (final)'.

BIM Review.Description: Review document focusing on the project's BIM implementation or model quality. Internal BIM process review; use findings to improve model coordination and standards adherence. Ask BIMsupport for guidance if needed.

BIM Translators.Description: Configuration files or translator settings for BIM software (e.g., for IFC export/import). Stored in the project BIM library; use for consistent data exchange between software platforms.

BIM other contractual documents (draft B.Description: Draft version of other BIM-related contractual documents prepared by Bond Bryan. Final version (agreed) in 0-ProjectGovernance/ContractualAndLegal.

BIM other contractual documents (draft e.Description: Draft version of other BIM-related contractual documents provided by an external party. Final version (agreed) in 0-ProjectGovernance/ContractualAndLegal.

BIM other contractual documents (final).Description: Finalised BIM-related contractual documents for the project. Official versions; they supersede earlier drafts and form part of the contract. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-900x 'BIM other contractual documents (final)'.

BREEAM / LEED submission.Description: Submission documents for BREEAM or LEED certification, detailing sustainability compliance. Usually prepared by the sustainability consultant (external); include required reports and forms.

Backup models (rvt/pln).Description: Backup archive of BIM model files (e.g., Revit or ArchiCAD models) saved at key milestones. Stored with project milestones; use for restoring or reviewing earlier design versions.

Balconies information.Description: Technical information, drawings, or specifications for balconies provided by a specialist. External subcontractor content; integrate relevant details into design coordination.

Balcony Types Schedule.Description: Schedule of balcony types. Part of the 0700-0999 Other Schedules series. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-L-A-0702 'Balcony Types Schedule'.

Balustrade & Guarding Details.Description: Balustrade, guarding and balcony type details. Sub-series range 7250-7299. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-D-A-7250-7299 'Balustrade & Guarding Details'.

Bespoke rulesets (solibri).Description: Custom Solibri model-checking rulesets tailored for this project.

British Standard (project related).Description: British Standard publication relevant to the project (e.g., building code or guidance document). Over and above Building Regulations and Clients' issued contractual documents (ExternalDiscipline/X-Client).

Building Control Decision Notice.Description: Approval, decision, or completion certificate issued by Building Control or the Building Safety Regulator. External statutory record; retain for compliance and handover.

Building Control Submission.Description: Documents submitted for Building Control approval, demonstrating regulatory compliance. Major milestone submission; ensure all required drawings and reports are included.

Building Control tracker (modified).Description: Modified version of the building control tracker updated by Bond Bryan to monitor compliance. Internal tracking document; use this to keep tabs on building control items and compare with the original (OtherDisciplines/T-BuildingControl).

Building Control tracker (original).Description: Original building control tracker document, likely provided by the building control authority or client. External baseline tracker; reference this for official requirements and updates (modify and save in A-Architecture/L-Lists/4000-Trackers).

Building Grid and Cuboid.Description: Building grid and cuboid setting out drawing (PDF/DWG). Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-D-A-6250 'Building Grid and Cuboid'.

CDP drawings.Description: Contractor Design Portion (CDP) drawings provided by subcontractors for specialist elements. External technical drawings; coordinate these with the main design to ensure compatibility.

CEM Presentation.Description: Client Engagement Meeting. Bond Bryan internal presentation; refer to related meeting notes or context for full understanding.

COBie / Data client report.Description: COBie (Construction-Operations Building Information Exchange) data report prepared by the client Information Manager. Provided by the Information Manager (external); use it to align project data deliverables with client requirements.

Calculations Parking.Description: Calculation sheet determining parking space requirements or counts for the project. Internal calculation; ensure it meets local parking standards and incorporate into site planning.

Calculations Toilets.Description: Calculation sheet determining the required number of toilets (sanitary fixtures) for the project. Internal calculation; verify compliance with building regulations and occupancy needs.

Ceiling Details.Description: Ceiling and bulkhead details. Sub-series range 7000-7049. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-D-A-7000-7049 'Ceiling Details'.

Ceiling Strategy.Description: Ceiling strategy drawings. Sub-series range 8000-8049 (first document = first number in range +1, e.g. 8001). Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-D-A-8000-8049 'Ceiling Strategy'.

Change Control.Description: Log or register documenting changes to the project scope or design and their approval status. Internal change tracker; update whenever a change is proposed or implemented.

Clash detection report.Description: Report detailing the results of clash detection runs between different discipline models. Use it to coordinate with consultants on resolving design conflicts.

Coat Cupboard Schedule.Description: Schedule of coat cupboards. Part of the 0700-0999 Other Schedules series. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-L-A-0703 'Coat Cupboard Schedule'.

Collateral Warranty (draft).Description: Draft collateral warranty received for review prior to execution. Review terms and check with PI insurers before signing. Final version (signed) in 0-ProjectGovernance/ContractualAndLegal.

Collateral Warranty (signed).Description: Executed collateral warranty granting rights to a third party (e.g., funder, purchaser, or tenant). Official contractual record; retain with other executed agreements. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-900x 'Collateral Warranty (signed)'.

Column & Beams Details.Description: Column and beam details. Sub-series range 7650-7699. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-D-A-7650-7699 'Column & Beams Details'.

Comments CDP / Subcontractors.Description: Review comments compiled by Bond Bryan on subcontractor (CDP) submissions. Ensure these comments are sent to the subcontractors with recorded dates and status.

Comments Designers' pack.Description: Review comments on design packages or submissions from the design team. Ensure these comments are sent to the subcontractors with recorded dates and status.

Compliance Review.Description: Review document checking project compliance with specific standards or requirements. Internal compliance check; identify any issues to resolve for regulatory or client requirements.

Construction Phase Plan.Description: Construction Phase Plan produced by the principal contractor under CDM regulations. External H&S document; review before site activities commence.

Construction Record Drawings.Description: Final set of drawings showing the project as actually constructed. Do not issue 'As-built' but 'Construction Record'.

Contractor's Programme.Description: Construction programme issued by the contractor. External schedule; align design information release with these timelines.

Conveyance Plans.Description: Conveyance plans for legal/land transaction purposes (9000 series). Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-D-A-9002 'Conveyance Plans'.

Correspondence Record.Description: Record or log of project correspondence, including letters and official communications. To be read in conjunction with Change Control, Additional Fees approvals.

Cost Plan.Description: Cost plan or estimate provided by the quantity surveyor. External cost document; review against design development and flag divergences early.

Curtain Wall Details.Description: Curtain walling details. Sub-series range 7050-7099. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-D-A-7050-7099 'Curtain Wall Details'.

Curtain Wall Schedules and Elevations.Description: Curtain wall schedules and elevations. As many documents as the project needs within the series. Series range 0300-0399. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-L-A-0300-0399 'Curtain Wall Schedules and Elevations'.

DEIR (modified).Description: Modified version of the Employer’s Information Requirements (EIR) document adapted by Bond Bryan. Internal working version of client requirements; ensure it reflects the original OtherDisciplines/X-Client document

DEIR (original).Description: Original Employer’s Information Requirements (EIR) document likely provided by the client. External project requirements document; use as baseline for BIM and information delivery expectations. If modified save the new version to A-Architecture/L-Lists/1000-Programmes

DTM Presentation.Description: Design Team Meeting, prepared for a specific meeting or purpose. Bond Bryan internal presentation; consult meeting context or minutes for relevance and prepare relevant Agenda prior to the meeting.

Delay Schedule.Description: Record of delay events and their impact, maintained as a live tracker. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-L-A-4002 'Delay Schedule'.

Demolition GA Plans.Description: General arrangement plans showing demolition scope. As many documents as the project needs within the series. Series range 2300-2399. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-D-A-2300-2399 'Demolition GA Plans'.

Design GA Plans.Description: General arrangement floor plans, design stage (typically 1:200). As many documents as the project needs within the series. Series range 2000-2099. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-D-A-2000-2099 'Design GA Plans'.

Design Guidelines (project related).Description: Project-specific design guidelines or standards document. Over and above Building Regulations and Clients' issued contractual documents (ExternalDiscipline/X-Client).

Design Responsibility Matrix.Description: Matrix defining the responsibility of each party for various design elements and deliverables. Contractual document; ensures clarity on roles and responsibilities across the design team. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-L-A-900x 'Design Responsibility Matrix'.

Design Review.Description: Document summarising discussions and outcomes of a design review meeting. Internal review record; use to implement agreed changes and track decisions.

Design and Access Statement.Description: Design and Access Statement explaining the design concept and site access, typically for planning. Prepared by Bond Bryan; required for planning submission to justify design decisions. Final version (when submitted) saved in 0-ProjectMilestones/Gateway1-PlanningApplication.

Designers Risk Assessment.Description: Designers risk assessment identifying and mitigating design-related health and safety risks (CDM). Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-4009 'Designers Risk Assessment'.

Detailed Plans.Description: Current set of drawing files in PDF format: the latest revision of every drawing regardless of issue date. Navigate here for the up-to-date set without superseded revisions alongside. File within the relevant drawing series subfolder

Details Drawings.Description: Generic entry for all detail drawings (7000-7999); see the named sub-series entries for specific detail types. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-D-A-7000-7999 'Details Drawings'.

Door Details.Description: External and internal door details, head/jamb/sill. Sub-series range 7100-7149. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-D-A-7100-7149 'Door Details'.

Door Schedules and Elevations.Description: Internal and external door schedules and door elevations. As many documents as the project needs within the series. Series range 0100-0199. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-L-A-0100-0199 'Door Schedules and Elevations'.

Door and gates schedule (Landscape).Description: Landscape schedule of doors and gates, including specifications and details. Internal landscape schedule; coordinate with architectural door schedules for consistency where relevant.

Drawing Register.Description: Register listing all project drawings with details like numbers, titles, and revisions. Bond Bryan internal list; keep updated to manage drawing issues and revisions.

Drawings DWG Archive/Superseded.Description: Archive of superseded drawing files in DWG format. Bond Bryan drawing archive; refer to these only for historical record, not current use. File within the relevant drawing series subfolder (e.g. 2000-FloorPlans).

Drawings DWG Current Version.Description: Current set of drawing files in DWG format: the latest revision of every drawing regardless of issue date. Navigate here for the up-to-date set without superseded revisions alongside. File within the relevant drawing series subfolder (e.g. 2000-FloorPlans).

Drawings DWG WIP.Description: Drawing files in DWG format issued from ArchiCAD into a numbered TransmittalSet folder (XX-Description, e.g. 01-InternalDesignReview) while the transmittal register is still open. Files carry the '_WIP' suffix to show the issue is internal and uncontrolled. Once reviewed and approved, the register is closed, the suffix is dropped and the drawings are issued automatically as the next numbered set (e.g. 02-IssueToClient). Issue sets are point-in-time records; never edit or add files after creation.

Drawings PDF Archive/Superseded.Description: Archive of superseded drawing files in PDF format. Historical record of issued drawings; ensure only the Current folder is used for reference. File within the relevant drawing series subfolder (e.g. 2000-FloorPlans).

Drawings PDF Current Version.Description: Current set of drawing files in PDF format: the latest revision of every drawing regardless of issue date. Navigate here for the up-to-date set without superseded revisions alongside. File within the relevant drawing series subfolder (e.g. 2000-FloorPlans).

Drawings PDF Issue Set.Description: Formal issue set of PDF drawings in a numbered TransmittalSet folder (XX-Description, e.g. 02-IssueToClient), created automatically from ArchiCAD when the transmittal register is closed. Files carry no '_WIP' suffix. Each set is a point-in-time record of exactly what was issued; never edit or add files after creation.

Drawings PDF WIP.Description: Drawing files in PDF format issued from ArchiCAD into a numbered TransmittalSet folder (XX-Description, e.g. 01-InternalDesignReview) while the transmittal register is still open. Files carry the '_WIP' suffix to show the issue is internal and uncontrolled. Once reviewed and approved, the register is closed, the suffix is dropped and the drawings are issued automatically as the next numbered set (e.g. 02-IssueToClient). Issue sets are point-in-time records; never edit or add files after creation.

Duty of Care (draft).Description: Draft duty of care letter or document prepared before formal agreement. External draft (likely client-provided); final signed version in 0-ProjectGovernance/ContractualAndLegal.

Duty of Care (signed).Description: Signed duty of care letter or agreement for the project. Official executed document; keep on record for compliance and reference. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-900x 'Duty of Care (signed)'.

Ecology and Arboricultural Reports.Description: Ecology, biodiversity, or arboricultural reports from the specialist consultant. External documents; coordinate with landscape design and planning requirements.

Elements Schedules.Description: Schedules listing building elements (e.g., windows, doors, etc.) produced by BIM software. File within the relevant schedule subfolder (e.g. 0100-Doors, 0200-WindowsAndLouvres).

Elevations (Architecture).Description: Current set of drawing files in PDF format: the latest revision of every drawing regardless of issue date. Navigate here for the up-to-date set without superseded revisions alongside. File within the relevant drawing series subfolder

Elevations (Interiors).Description: Current set of drawing files in PDF format: the latest revision of every drawing regardless of issue date. Navigate here for the up-to-date set without superseded revisions alongside. File within the relevant drawing series subfolder

Elevations (Landscape).Description: Current set of drawing files in PDF format: the latest revision of every drawing regardless of issue date. Navigate here for the up-to-date set without superseded revisions alongside. File within the relevant drawing series subfolder

Email saved (for record).Description: Saved email correspondence kept on file for project record-keeping. Bond Bryan internal archive; key communications saved here for accountability and reference. Not all emails need to be saved.

Existing Building Fabric analysis (Inter.Description: Description and analysis drawings and report of existing fabric of a building for refurbishments and retrofit projects.

Existing GA Plans.Description: General arrangement floor plans of the existing building. As many documents as the project needs within the series. Series range 2200-2299. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-D-A-2200-2299 'Existing GA Plans'.

Fees approved.Description: Documents confirming the approval of the agreed project fees. Formal record of fee agreements; filed under project administration for reference. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-900x 'Fees approved'.

Fees calculations.Description: Calculations or breakdown documents for the project fee structure. Internal breakdown of fees; use to calculate fees in line with Rapport3 workflows. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-L-A-900x 'Fees calculations'.

Fees letter.Description: Letter regarding project fees, such as a fee proposal or agreement letter. Official fee correspondence; maintain as part of the contract records. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-900x 'Fees letter'.

File Note.Description: Internal file note documenting a conversation, decision, or instruction for record. Used to capture informal decisions; ensure important points are recorded for future reference.

Finishes Drawings.Description: Generic entry for all finishes drawings (8000-8999); see the named sub-series entries for specific types. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-D-A-8000-8999 'Finishes Drawings'.

Finishes schedule.Description: Schedule listing all finish materials (flooring, paint, etc.) and their specifications. Internal design schedule; coordinate with room data sheets and specifications.

Fire Engineer report.Description: Fire engineering report provided by the project's fire engineering consultant. External fire safety document; implement its recommendations and ensure code compliance.

Fire Strategy drawings.Description: Current set of drawing files in PDF format: the latest revision of every drawing regardless of issue date. Navigate here for the up-to-date set without superseded revisions alongside. File within the relevant drawing series subfolder

Floor Details.Description: Floor junction details and floor build-up types. Sub-series range 7150-7199. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-D-A-7150-7199 'Floor Details'.

Floor Finishes Plans.Description: Floor finishes plans. Sub-series range 8150-8199 (first document = first number in range +1, e.g. 8151). Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-D-A-8150-8199 'Floor Finishes Plans'.

Floor Finishes Strategy.Description: Floor finishes strategy drawings. Sub-series range 8100-8149 (first document = first number in range +1, e.g. 8101). Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-D-A-8100-8149 'Floor Finishes Strategy'.

Furniture Details.Description: Fitted furniture and joinery details: reception desks, counters, cupboards, wardrobes. Sub-series range 7200-7249. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-D-A-7200-7249 'Furniture Details'.

Furniture schedule (Landscape).Description: Landscape schedule of furniture, including specifications and details. Internal landscape schedule; coordinate with interior design furniture schedules for consistency where relevant.

GA floor Plans (Interiors).Description: Current set of drawing files in PDF format: the latest revision of every drawing regardless of issue date. Navigate here for the up-to-date set without superseded revisions alongside. File within the relevant drawing series subfolder

Gateway 2 Submission.Description: Documents submitted at Gateway 2 (Building Control application). Milestone record; keep the complete submitted package for audit.

Gateway 3 Submission.Description: Documents compiled at Gateway 3 (completion), including completion certificates and handover records. Milestone record; archive the complete package.

Glazed Screen Schedules and Elevations.Description: Internal glazed screen schedules and elevations. As many documents as the project needs within the series. Series range 0200-0299. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-L-A-0200-0299 'Glazed Screen Schedules and Elevations'.

H&S Designer Competence Assessment.Description: Assessment form evaluating the competence of designers from a health and safety (CDM) perspective. Complete for all design team members as per CDM requirements.

H&S Designer Risk Assessment.Description: Risk assessment focusing on design-stage health and safety considerations (CDM regulations). Internal CDM risk assessment; update as design evolves to address and mitigate risks.

HRB submission.Description: Submission documents for a Higher-Risk Building (HRB) in line with new building safety regulations. Regulatory submission; coordinate closely with the building safety regulator and include all required details.

Health and Safety File.Description: Health and Safety File compiled under CDM 2015 when Bond Bryan is appointed Principal Designer (CDM), and handed to the client at project completion. Keep the issued version with the handover milestone records (0-ProjectMilestones/RIBAStage6-Handover and Gateway3-Completion). If an external Principal Designer holds the appointment, file their version in OtherDisciplines/O-PrincipalDesigner/CDM.

Heat Loss Calculation Report.Description: Report analysing building heat loss to inform thermal performance and insulation requirements. technical report with expertise from specialist; cross-check with M&E consultant data to ensure energy efficiency targets.

Historic analysis (Interior).Description: Description and analysis drawings and report of historic building for refurbishments and retrofit projects.

Historic analysis (PDBR).Description: Description and analysis drawings and report of historic building for refurbishments and retrofit projects.

Historic building fabric analysis (retro.Description: Historic analysis drawings or documents to request specific surveys in retrofit projects.

IFC Library.Description: Library of IFC (Industry Foundation Classes) files imported in BIM software. Delete old library files when not in use (only latest versions to be kept).

ITT Answer Plan.Description: Plan for a single scored ITT question setting out the win themes, evidence to be used, page/word count, author and reviewer before any drafting starts. One answer plan per question; agree with the bid lead, then draft in 9700-DraftAnswers. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-9601-Answer Plan Q01-P01.

ITT Answer Storyboard.Description: Page-by-page storyboard showing how an answer will be laid out within the permitted page count, including where images and diagrams sit. Bid-stage layout planning only; the formatted submission artwork sits in 9800-DraftSubmission. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-9602-Answer Storyboard-P01.

ITT Bid Diagram.Description: Diagram or graphic produced for the tender answers (early-stage concept sketches, site and massing diagrams, process, programme and organisation graphics). Bid-stage illustrative material only, not coordinated design information; do not reuse as project drawings. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-I-A-9902-Bid Diagram-P01.

ITT Bid Go-NoGo and Compliance Checklist.Description: Record of the go/no-go decision to bid, plus the compliance checklist confirming every mandatory ITT requirement, form and certificate is covered. Complete the go/no-go before committing resource; re-check compliance immediately before upload. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-L-A-9504-Go NoGo and Compliance Checklist-P01.

ITT Bid Image.Description: Image selected and prepared for use in the tender submission (early-stage concept views, precedent imagery, completed project photography). Bid-stage imagery only; check photographer credits and image rights, and that the client may be named, before use. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-I-A-9901-Bid Image-P01.

ITT Bid Plan.Description: Overall plan for the tender response: bid team and roles, win strategy and themes, deliverables, key dates and submission route. Baseline document for the bid; issue at bid kick-off and update as the ITT develops. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-9501-Bid Plan-P01.

ITT Bid Programme.Description: Programme of bid activities and internal deadlines worked back from the client's submission deadline (discipline inputs, drafting, red team review, sign-off, portal upload). Allow time for internal review and upload ahead of the client deadline. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-L-A-9502-Bid Programme-P01.

ITT Bid Tracker.Description: Live tracker of every ITT question and requirement showing author, reviewer, status, word/page count and any clarifications raised with the client. Single source of truth for bid progress; update at every bid review. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-L-A-9503-Bid Tracker-P01.

ITT Client Documentation.Description: Invitation to Tender documents provided by the client during pre-commission. External tender info from the client; includes project brief, requirements, etc., to guide Bond Bryan's bid. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-900x 'ITT Client Documentation'.

ITT Discipline Input Images.Description: Images, sketches and diagrams supplied by a discipline to support the bid (early-stage concept work, precedent projects, discipline-specific graphics). File in the relevant discipline folder and dated 'YYYY-MM_DD Description' subfolder; raw supplied material only, selected and resized images for the submission go to 9900-images. Check image rights before use. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-I-[A/I/L/O]-9404-Discipline Input Image-P01.

ITT Discipline Input Statement.Description: Written input from an individual discipline (architecture, interior design, landscape architecture or principal designer) supplying approach, method and technical content for the bid answers. File in the relevant discipline folder and dated 'YYYY-MM_DD Description' subfolder; raw input only, the edited text belongs in 9700-DraftAnswers. Role code matches the discipline folder. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-[A/I/L/O]-9401-Discipline Input Statement-P01.

ITT Discipline Project Experience Sheet.Description: Comparable project sheet supplied by a discipline as evidence of relevant experience (project data, value, scope, role and outcomes). File in the relevant discipline folder and dated 'YYYY-MM_DD Description' subfolder; confirm the project may be referenced publicly and the client is content to be named. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-[A/I/L/O]-9402-Project Experience Sheet-P01.

ITT Discipline Team CV.Description: CV or role profile for a proposed team member supplied by their discipline for use in the bid. File in the relevant discipline folder and dated 'YYYY-MM_DD Description' subfolder; use the current practice CV template. The bid-edited version is saved in 9700-DraftAnswers. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-[A/I/L/O]-9403-Team CV Surname-P01.

ITT Draft Answer.Description: Working draft of the response to a single ITT question, written against its answer plan in 9600-AnswerPlans. One file per question; keep drafting here until signed off, then collate into 9800-DraftSubmission. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-9701-Draft Answer Q01-P01.

ITT Draft Answer Review Comments.Description: Reviewer comments and mark-ups on draft answers (red team review), recorded against the question they relate to. Close out every comment and record the change in the bid tracker. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-9704-Draft Answer Review Comments-P01.

ITT Draft CV.Description: Bid-edited CV for a named team member, tailored to the ITT questions, role and word count. Edited from the discipline CV supplied in 9400-DisciplineInputs; keep the named role consistent with the organisation chart. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-9702-Draft CV Surname-P01.

ITT Draft Case Study.Description: Draft project case study written for the tender, developed from the experience sheets supplied in 9400-DisciplineInputs. Confirm figures, dates, images and client references are accurate and cleared before submission. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-9703-Draft Case Study-P01.

ITT Draft Fee Proposal.Description: Draft fee and resource build-up for the tender, including stage fee breakdown and any pricing schedule required by the client. Commercially sensitive; must be approved by the bid director before submission. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-L-A-9803-Draft Fee Proposal-P01.

ITT Draft Submission Document.Description: Collated draft of the full tender document with all signed-off answers, imagery and formatting applied, ready for final review. Working version only; the issued package is saved in the ITT Submission folder. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-9801-Draft Submission-P01.

ITT Draft Submission Forms.Description: Completed client-issued forms, certificates and declarations required with the tender (form of tender, insurances, policies, standard questionnaires). Check every mandatory form is completed and signed before upload; cross-check against the compliance checklist. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-9802-Draft Submission Forms-P01.

ITT Draft Submission Review Comments.Description: Final review comments and mark-ups on the collated draft submission ahead of sign-off. Record the sign-off decision; the approved file becomes the package saved in the ITT Submission folder. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-9804-Draft Submission Review Comments-P01.

ITT Drawings.Description: Drawings prepared by Bond Bryan for the Invitation to Tender package. Internal drawings for tender submission; ensure they meet client tender requirements. Bid-stage drawings and sketch proposals used inside answers are saved with the other bid graphics in 9900-images. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-D-A-900x 'ITT Drawings'.

ITT External Originals.Description: Original drawings or documents from external sources included in the tender package. External reference materials for tender; maintain these for completeness and clarification. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-D-A-900x 'ITT External Originals'.

ITT Feedback and results.Description: Documents containing feedback and results from the tender process. Outcome of the tender stage; review to inform adjustments or negotiations. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-900x 'ITT Feedback and results'.

ITT Organisation Chart.Description: Project team organisation chart prepared for the tender showing named roles, reporting lines and the wider consultant team. Keep aligned with the draft CVs and the resourcing described in the answers. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-I-A-9903-Organisation Chart-P01.

ITT Question Requirements Matrix.Description: Matrix mapping every ITT question to the client's stated requirements, evaluation criteria and weightings, with the responsible author against each. Use to confirm nothing in the ITT is unanswered and effort is weighted to the highest-scoring questions. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-L-A-9603-Question Requirements Matrix-P01.

ITT Report.Description: Report summarising the Invitation to Tender process or submissions. Bond Bryan internal analysis; documents tender responses and recommendations. File within the relevant BBAOriginals subfolder where it relates to a specific bid stage. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-900x 'ITT Report'.

ITT Team Photograph.Description: Portrait photographs of the proposed team for use alongside the CVs in the submission. Use current practice portraits at a consistent crop and size across the whole team. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-I-A-9904-Team Photograph Surname-P01.

ITT-Submission.Description: Submitted tender package documents for the Invitation to Tender. Final tender submission; archive this as the official bid sent to the client. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-900x 'ITT-Submission'.

Images Precedent.Description: Collection of precedent images (reference photos or case studies) relevant to the project. Stored in the project library; use for design inspiration or to communicate ideas to the client.

Incoming Documents.Description: General incoming documents from external parties. External documents; sort and file these into appropriate discipline folders after review and save in renamed YYYY-MM-DD Description folder.

Incoming Drawings.Description: General incoming drawings from external parties. External documents; sort and file these into appropriate discipline folders after review and save in renamed YYYY-MM-DD Description folder.

Individual Room Layouts.Description: Individual room/space layouts (typically 1:20). Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-D-A-5002 'Individual Room Layouts'.

Interior specific Documents (appointed).Description: Interior design documents produced by Bond Bryan interior design team (separately appointed).

Interior specific Drawings (appointed).Description: Interior design documents produced by Bond Bryan interior design team (separately appointed).

Interior specific Lists (appointed).Description: Interior design documents produced by Bond Bryan interior design team (separately appointed).

Ironmongery Sets Schedule.Description: Schedule of ironmongery sets, coordinated with door schedules; numbered within the 0100 Doors series (TIDP example: 0105). Series range 0100-0199. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-L-A-0100-0199 'Ironmongery Sets Schedule'.

JCT Contract (draft).Description: Draft JCT (Joint Contracts Tribunal) construction contract prepared for review. Preliminary contract version; finalise terms and obtain signatures for the final contract. Final version (signed) in 0-ProjectGovernance/ContractualAndLegal.

JCT Contract (final).Description: Final JCT (Joint Contracts Tribunal) contract document for the project. Signed construction contract; the binding agreement governing project delivery. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-900x 'JCT Contract (final)'.

K10 Partitions.Description: Technical documents or specifications related to partition systems (labelled under code K10). Provided by a partitions subcontractor; integrate with architectural specifications and drawings.

Landscape Documents (appointed).Description: Landscape architecture documents produced by the Bond Bryan landscape architect (separately appointed).

Landscape Drawings (appointed).Description: Landscape architecture documents produced by the Bond Bryan landscape architect (separately appointed).

Landscape Lists (appointed).Description: Landscape architecture documents produced by the Bond Bryan landscape architect (separately appointed).

Letter of compliance.Description: Letter certifying compliance with specific requirements or regulations for the project. Bond Bryan correspondence; retain for record to demonstrate adherence to standards or conditions.

Lift Details.Description: Lift details. Sub-series range 7500-7549. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-D-A-7500-7549 'Lift Details'.

Lift information.Description: Technical information or specifications for lifts and escalators from the specialist supplier. External supplier data; incorporate into building design and coordinate with structural and MEP plans.

Location Plan.Description: Site location plan identifying the site in its wider context (typically 1:1250). Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-D-A-1001 'Location Plan'.

Logos.Description: Collection of project-related logos (client, consultants, etc.) in image format. For use in presentations and BIM model; ensure only current official logos are used.

MIDP.Description: Master Information Delivery Plan outlining all project information deliverables and responsibilities. Provided by the Information Manager (external); use to coordinate Bond Bryan's TIDP and overall deliverables.

Maintenance strategy drawings.Description: Current set of drawing files in PDF format: the latest revision of every drawing regardless of issue date. Navigate here for the up-to-date set without superseded revisions alongside. File within the relevant drawing series subfolder

Markup scanned.Description: Collection of scanned drawings and markups for the project. Internal creative drawings; use these for brainstorming and early client discussions. Mark up to specific CDP / designer packs to be saved in Comments folder.

Method Statement.Description: Method statement document describing how a specific work task will be carried out safely and effectively.

Milestone Records (Drawings, reports, co.Description: Archive of documents (drawings, reports, contracts, etc.) compiled at each project milestone. Central milestone archive; review to track what was delivered at each stage.

Minutes (BB produced).Description: Meeting minutes documented by Bond Bryan summarising discussions and actions.

Minutes (Incoming).Description: Meeting minutes received from an external party or consultant. External meeting record; cross-check with Bond Bryan's minutes to ensure consistent understanding.

Model Federated.Description: Federated BIM model combining all discipline models into one for coordination. Compiled by Bond Bryan; use for clash detection.

Model IFC (BB produced).Description: IFC (Industry Foundation Classes) model exported by Bond Bryan from the native design model. Internal IFC export; share with consultants and combine with incoming IFCs for coordination in 'Model Federated'.

Model IFC (incoming).Description: IFC model file received from an external consultant's design. External model input; import or reference it in the federated model and/or BIM model and verify alignment.

Model Native (rvt/pln).Description: Native BIM model files (e.g., Revit .rvt or ArchiCAD .pln) used for developing the design. Bond Bryan working models; keep versions archived and coordinate sharing as needed.

NDA / Confidentiality Agreement.Description: Non-disclosure or confidentiality agreement relating to the project. Official executed document; check obligations before sharing project information externally. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-900x 'NDA / Confidentiality Agreement'.

Novation Agreement.Description: Agreement novating Bond Bryan's appointment, typically from client to contractor on design and build projects. Official executed document; note the change of client for correspondence and instructions. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-900x 'Novation Agreement'.

Other Contract documents (draft).Description: Draft miscellaneous contract documents prepared or provided before finalisation. Likely client-issued drafts; review and revise before executing final copies.

Other Contract documents (final).Description: Finalised miscellaneous contract documents for the project. Official documents on file; reference these for any contract clarifications. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-900x 'Other Contract documents (final)'.

Other Details.Description: Other details not covered by the named 7000 sub-series. Sub-series range 7700-7999. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-D-A-7700-7999 'Other Details'.

Other Reviews.Description: Miscellaneous project review documents not covered by specific review categories.

Other Schedules.Description: Miscellaneous schedules or lists that don't fit other specific categories.

Other calculations.Description: Miscellaneous calculation documents or spreadsheets not covered by specific categories. Internal calculations; update and verify these as the design evolves.

Other comments.Description: General comment or review documents that do not fall under specific categories.

Outsourcing Briefing.Description: Briefing document outlining tasks or scope to be outsourced.

Outsourcing Comments.Description: Comments or feedback related to outsourced work or externally produced content. Marked up drawings and documents.

Outsourcing Tracker.Description: Tracker for outsourced packages or tasks, monitoring their progress and status.

PDBR Documents (appointed).Description: Documents related to the Principal Designer (Building Regulations) role, compiled by the appointed team. Internal building regs compliance documentation; coordinate with any external PDBR documents if applicable.

PDBR Documents (external).Description: Principal Designer (Building Regulations) documents provided by an external consultant. External building regs compliance docs; ensure the internal team reviews and aligns with these.

PDBR Drawings (appointed).Description: Drawings focusing on building regulations compliance produced by the appointed Principal Designer. Internal compliance drawings; include these in the design set and coordinate with external PD if needed.

PDBR Drawings (external).Description: Drawings from an external Principal Designer (Building Regulations) focusing on compliance. External compliance drawings; confirm they are integrated into the project documentation.

PDBR Lists (appointed).Description: Lists or schedules (e.g., compliance checklists) maintained by the appointed Principal Designer (Building Regulations). Internal compliance lists; keep them updated and cross-reference with external lists if provided.

PDBR Lists (external).Description: Compliance lists or schedules from an external Principal Designer (Building Regulations). External compliance lists; verify all items are addressed in internal documents.

PDCDM Documents (appointed).Description: Documents related to the Principal Designer (CDM regulations) role, produced by the appointed team. Internal health & safety documentation; coordinate with external PD documents if the role is external.

PDCDM Documents (external).Description: Principal Designer (CDM) documents provided by an external party responsible for CDM duties. External CDM documents; ensure Bond Bryan reviews these to align with design processes.

PDCDM Drawings (appointed).Description: Drawings related to CDM (Construction Design & Management) considerations by the appointed team. Internal safety-related drawings; coordinate with external PD if one is appointed outside.

PDCDM Drawings (external).Description: Drawings focusing on CDM/safety provided by an external Principal Designer. External safety drawings; include in project info and ensure compliance with them.

PDCDM Lists (appointed).Description: Lists or schedules (like risk registers) created by the appointed Principal Designer under CDM. Internal PD CDM lists; update regularly and share with the team for compliance.

PDCDM Lists (external).Description: Lists or schedules from an external Principal Designer under CDM (e.g., risk assessments, registers). External H&S lists; ensure all items are tracked and addressed in project planning.

PI Insurance Certificate.Description: Professional indemnity insurance certificate or evidence of cover for the project. Retain to satisfy appointment obligations; replace on annual renewal. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-900x 'PI Insurance Certificate'.

PQQ Bid Diagram.Description: Diagram or graphic produced for the PQQ answers (practice capability, quality and resourcing diagrams, early-stage concept sketches where a design response is requested). Pre-qualification stage illustrative material only; not coordinated design information. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-I-A-9902-Bid Diagram-P01.

PQQ Bid Image.Description: Image selected and prepared for use in the PQQ submission (completed project photography, precedent imagery, early-stage concept views). Check photographer credits, image rights and that the referenced client may be named. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-I-A-9901-Bid Image-P01.

PQQ Client Documentation.Description: Pre-Qualification Questionnaire documents provided by the client during the pre-commission phase. External pre-commission info; outlines project basics and client requirements for initial bids. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-900x 'PQQ Client Documentation'.

PQQ Draft Answer.Description: Working draft of the response to a single PQQ question. One file per question; keep drafting here until signed off, then collate into 9800-DraftSubmission. Reuse approved practice standard text where the question allows. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-9701-Draft Answer Q01-P01.

PQQ Draft CV.Description: Bid-edited CV for a named team member, tailored to the PQQ role and word count. Use the current practice CV template; keep the named role consistent with the organisation chart. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-9702-Draft CV Surname-P01.

PQQ Draft Case Study.Description: Draft comparable project case study written for the PQQ as evidence of relevant experience. Confirm figures, dates, images and client references are accurate and cleared before submission. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-9703-Draft Case Study-P01.

PQQ Draft Submission Document.Description: Collated draft of the full PQQ response with all signed-off answers, imagery and formatting applied, ready for final review. Working version only; the issued package is saved in the PQQ Submission folder. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-9801-Draft Submission-P01.

PQQ Draft Submission Forms.Description: Completed client-issued PQQ forms, certificates and declarations (insurances, health and safety, quality and environmental accreditations, financial information). Check every mandatory form is completed and signed, and accreditations are in date, before upload. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-9802-Draft Submission Forms-P01.

PQQ Draft Submission Review Comments.Description: Review comments and mark-ups on the collated draft PQQ response ahead of sign-off. Close out every comment and record the sign-off decision; the approved file becomes the package saved in the PQQ Submission folder. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-9803-Draft Submission Review Comments-P01.

PQQ Drawings.Description: Drawings prepared by Bond Bryan for the Pre-Qualification Questionnaire submission. Internal drawings for PQQ; ensure they address client requirements at this early stage. Bid-stage sketches and graphics used inside answers are saved with the other bid imagery in 9900-images. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-D-A-900x 'PQQ Drawings'.

PQQ External Originals.Description: Original drawings or documents from external sources used in the PQQ stage. External references in the PQQ; keep for completeness and as context for Bond Bryan's submission. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-D-A-900x 'PQQ External Originals'.

PQQ Feedback and results.Description: Documents containing feedback or results from the PQQ process (e.g., shortlist outcomes). Outcome of pre-qualification; use insights to improve for the tender stage. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-900x 'PQQ Feedback and results'.

PQQ Organisation Chart.Description: Project team organisation chart prepared for the PQQ showing named roles, reporting lines and the wider consultant team. Keep aligned with the draft CVs and the resourcing described in the answers. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-I-A-9903-Organisation Chart-P01.

PQQ-Submission.Description: Submitted Pre-Qualification Questionnaire documents (complete PQQ response package). Final PQQ submission; record of Bond Bryan's initial bid information. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-900x 'PQQ-Submission'.

Photograph Existing.Description: Photographs of the existing site or structures taken before project work begins. Internal project photo record; use as a baseline to compare against construction progress and completion.

Photograph Post Completion.Description: Photographs taken after project completion, showing the finished building and site. Notify marketing team.

Pictures Site visit.Description: Photographs captured during site visits to document progress or issues. Internal site visit photos; use for progress reports and to record on-site conditions.

Planning Decision Notice.Description: Formal decision notice issued by the local planning authority, including planning conditions. External statutory document; track the discharge of conditions through the project.

Planning Submission and documents.Description: Documents compiled for the planning application submission (forms, drawings, reports). Submitted information, WIP drawings/documents to be saved elsewhere.

Planning consultation boards.Description: Display boards prepared for planning consultation events, showing project plans and information. Bond Bryan presentation materials; update these as the design evolves for public or stakeholder consultations.

Planting schedule (Landscape).Description: Landscape schedule of planting, including specifications and details.

Pre-application Advice.Description: Pre-application advice or correspondence from the local planning authority. External guidance; use to shape the planning submission strategy.

Presentation Main file (Affinity).Description: Primary presentation document created in Affinity design software format. Original editable file; export to PDF when sharing with those without Affinity.

Presentation Main file (InDesign).Description: Primary presentation document created in Adobe InDesign format. Original editable InDesign file; used for high-quality layouts, export PDFs for distribution.

Presentation Main file (PowerPoint).Description: Primary presentation document created in Microsoft PowerPoint format. Editable PowerPoint file; convenient for client presentations and quick updates.

Product reference.Description: Reference document for a specific product (e.g., technical datasheet or brochure) used in the project. External product info from a supplier; refer to it when specifying or coordinating that product.

Programme (BB produced).Description: Project programme (schedule) developed by Bond Bryan outlining tasks and timelines. Internal project schedule; align it with any master programme provided by the client or PM.

Programme (incoming).Description: Project programme received from the client or external project manager. External master schedule; ensure Bond Bryan's activities align with these timelines.

Progress report.Description: Report detailing the progress of the project over a certain period. Bond Bryan progress update; share with the client and use to track against the programme.

Project Directory.Description: Directory of project contacts, listing key team members and their contact information. Keep this updated as personnel change - also on Rapport3 / external team. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-L-A-900x 'Project Directory'.

Project Quality Management Plan.Description: Outlines the quality assurance and control procedures for the project. Use as a reference for QA process expectations at all phases.

RIBA Stage Completion.Description: Documents marking the completion of a RIBA work stage (deliverables compiled at stage end). Milestone records for each RIBA stage; archive these for reference and auditing.

RVT Families.Description: Library of Revit family components (doors, windows, etc.) used in the project model. Stored in BIM library; ensure all team members use the approved families for consistency.

Re-use schedule of elements.Description: Elements carefully set aside and reused in the design.

Reflected Ceiling Plans.Description: Reflected ceiling plans. Sub-series range 8050-8099 (first document = first number in range +1, e.g. 8051). Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-D-A-8050-8099 'Reflected Ceiling Plans'.

Request for Information (RFI) Incoming.Description: Log of RFIs raised by contractors and the corresponding clarifications provided by the design team. Helps track unresolved or pending technical clarifications.

Request for Information (RFI) Outgoing.Description: Log of RFIs raised by BB and the corresponding clarifications provided by the design team. Helps track unresolved or pending technical clarifications.

Roof & Roof Accessories Details.Description: Roof, roof accessories and external soffit details. Sub-series range 7300-7349. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-D-A-7300-7349 'Roof & Roof Accessories Details'.

Room Data Sheets (RDS).Description: Room Data Sheets (RDS) detailing requirements and specifications for each room/space. Internal project documents; update these as design details are finalised and verify with client requirements.

Room Elevations (Architecture).Description: Current set of drawing files in PDF format: the latest revision of every drawing regardless of issue date. Navigate here for the up-to-date set without superseded revisions alongside. File within the relevant drawing series subfolder

Room Elevations (Interiors).Description: Current set of drawing files in PDF format: the latest revision of every drawing regardless of issue date. Navigate here for the up-to-date set without superseded revisions alongside. File within the relevant drawing series subfolder

Sales Plans.Description: Sales and marketing plans (9000 series). Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-D-A-9003 'Sales Plans'.

Sanitary Layouts.Description: Individual sanitary space layouts (typically 1:20). Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-D-A-5001 'Sanitary Layouts'.

Sanitaryware schedule.Description: Schedule listing sanitary fixtures (sinks, toilets, etc.) and their specifications for the project. Internal schedule; coordinate with plumbing layouts and ensure items match the design. Bond Bryan produced document supplier information to be included in ExternalDiscipline/X-Subcontractors.

Schedule of accommodation.Description: Schedule of accommodation outlining all spaces/rooms and their areas against requirements.

Sections.Description: Current set of drawing files in PDF format: the latest revision of every drawing regardless of issue date. Navigate here for the up-to-date set without superseded revisions alongside. File within the relevant drawing series subfolder

Sections (Interiors).Description: Current set of drawing files in PDF format: the latest revision of every drawing regardless of issue date. Navigate here for the up-to-date set without superseded revisions alongside. File within the relevant drawing series subfolder

Sections (Landscape).Description: Current set of drawing files in PDF format: the latest revision of every drawing regardless of issue date. Navigate here for the up-to-date set without superseded revisions alongside. File within the relevant drawing series subfolder

Signage Details.Description: Signage setting out and details. Sub-series range 7350-7399. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-D-A-7350-7399 'Signage Details'.

Site Plans (Architecture).Description: Current set of drawing files in PDF format: the latest revision of every drawing regardless of issue date. Navigate here for the up-to-date set without superseded revisions alongside. File within the relevant drawing series subfolder

Site Plans (Landscape).Description: Current set of drawing files in PDF format: the latest revision of every drawing regardless of issue date. Navigate here for the up-to-date set without superseded revisions alongside. File within the relevant drawing series subfolder

Site visit report.Description: Report from a site visit, detailing observations, progress, and any issues noted. Bond Bryan site report; use to follow up on actions and inform the project team.

Sketch ideas.Description: Collection of sketch drawings and conceptual ideas for the project. Internal creative drawings; use these for brainstorming and early client discussions.

Slab & Waterproofing Details.Description: Slab and waterproofing details. Sub-series range 7400-7449. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-D-A-7400-7449 'Slab & Waterproofing Details'.

Snagging Lists.Description: List of issues or incomplete works to be addressed before project handover. Coordinate with final inspections and closeout documentation.

Specifications BB produced document.Description: Project specification documents produced by Bond Bryan. Produced in NBS Chorus, pdf record here only.

Specifications incoming doc.Description: Specification documents received from an external source (consultant or subcontractor). External spec content; integrate relevant sections into the project's overall specifications on NBS Chorus.

Stage Report.Description: Formal report summarising the work completed and decisions made at a project stage. Bond Bryan deliverable; provides a record of design progress at that RIBA stage for the client.

Stairs & Ramp Details.Description: Stair and ramp plan and section details. Sub-series range 7450-7499. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-D-A-7450-7499 'Stairs & Ramp Details'.

Standards and guidance (outside of contr.Description: Standards and guidance documents relevant to the project but not part of the contract requirements.

Strategic Brief Development.Description: Document outlining the development of the project's strategic brief (high-level goals and needs).

Strategic Headcount List.Description: List detailing the anticipated headcount or occupancy numbers for strategic planning.

Strategic Investment appraisals and cost.Description: Documents evaluating strategic investment options and their costs for the project.

Strategic Options Development.Description: Documents exploring various strategic development options or design directions for the project.

Strategic Space Need analysis.Description: Analysis of high-level space requirements and needs for the project.

Structural engineer's Documents.Description: Documents from the structural engineering consultant, such as reports or calculations. External structural documentation; coordinate with architectural information for consistency.

Structural engineer's Drawings.Description: Drawings provided by the structural engineer detailing structural elements. External structural drawings; integrate with architectural drawings to avoid conflicts.

Structural engineer's Models.Description: Digital models (IFC format only) provided by the structural engineering consultant. Link or merge into the federated model for coordination.

Sub-consultant Appointment.Description: Appointment agreement for sub-consultants engaged directly by Bond Bryan. Executed agreement; ensure scope and liability align with the main appointment. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-900x 'Sub-consultant Appointment'.

Subconsultant Invoices.Description: Invoices issued by a sub-consultant to Bond Bryan where BB acts as the appointing party for that consultant. Covers fee invoices for the sub-consultant's services rendered under BB's appointment; check against the agreed sub-consultant appointment and fee schedule, approve for payment, and retain for records and onward recovery from the client where applicable. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-900x 'Subconsultant Invoices'.

Subcontractor information.Description: General information or documents provided by subcontractors (could include drawings, specs, etc.). External subcontractor content; ensure relevant info is extracted and filed appropriately in project documents.

Supporting images for reports / presenta.Description: Supporting images for reports or presentations in Affinity format (original editable images). Source graphics files; use when editing or creating high-quality visuals, and export as needed.
Supporting images for reports or presentations in common image formats (JPEG/PNG). Ready-to-use images; insert into documents or slides as needed, original editing done in source files.

Survey Cetopo file (2D/3D).Description: Topographical survey file (2D/3D format) of the site, imported from Cetopo. External survey data; use for site modelling and ensure coordinate system matches project settings.

Survey GoogleMap / orthophoto.Description: Site location imagery (Google Map screenshots or orthophotos) for context reference. External map images; use for initial site analysis and presentations, noting they are for reference only.

Survey Incoming.Description: Incoming survey documents or data from external sources.

Survey OS Map (2D).Description: Ordnance Survey map (2D) of the project area. Official mapping data; use as base for site plans and ensure usage complies with licensing.

Survey request markup (Interior).Description: Mark up plans and documents for request of survey information for refurbishments and retrofit projects.

Survey request markup (PDBR).Description: Mark up plans and documents for request of survey information for refurbishments and retrofit projects.

Sustainability Carbon Assessments.Description: Documents assessing the project's carbon footprint or sustainable design performance. Bond Bryan internal sustainability documentation; coordinate findings with sustainability consultants.

Sustainability Project Briefing Document.Description: Document outlining the project's sustainability brief or objectives. Guides sustainable design decisions and aligns with client sustainability goals.

Sustainability Review.Description: Review document evaluating the project against sustainability targets or criteria.

TIDP.Description: Task Information Delivery Plan detailing specific information deliverables and who provides them. Bond Bryan's plan; aligns with the Master Information Delivery Plan (MIDP) to schedule information outputs.

Technical GA Plans.Description: General arrangement floor plans, technical/construction stage (typically 1:100/1:50). As many documents as the project needs within the series. Series range 2100-2199. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-D-A-2100-2199 'Technical GA Plans'.

Technical Review.Description: Technical review report examining the design for technical quality and compliance. Internal design QA/QC document; address any issues identified to maintain technical excellence.

Technical Submittals (Contractor).Description: Technical submittals issued by the contractor for review (product data, samples records, method details). External content; record review comments in the relevant Comments folder.

Tender Queries and Responses.Description: Compilation of questions from bidders and formal responses issued during the tender process. Ensure updates are reflected in Addenda if applicable.

Terms of Engagement (draft).Description: Draft version of the project's terms of engagement (contractual agreement) before signing. External draft (likely client-supplied); review and negotiate changes prior to signing the final version (0-ProjectGovernance/ContractualAndLegal)

Terms of Engagement (signed).Description: Signed final terms of engagement document for the project. Official agreement on project services; refer to this for scope and conditions of appointment. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-XX-XX-T-A-900x 'Terms of Engagement (signed)'.

Thermal Bridging.Description: Report or analysis focused on thermal bridging and insulation performance in the design. Requires expert documentation.

Topographical Survey.Description: Topographical survey data or drawings of the site from an external surveyor. Verify the coordinate system and datum match project settings before use.

Transmittal Sheet.Description: Transmittal sheet form recording details of documents issued to other parties. Internal record to accompany document issues; use to track distributions and acknowledgments.

Twinmotion file.Description: 3D visualisation scene file in Twinmotion format for rendering and animation. Internal visualisation content; update as the model changes and use for creating walkthroughs.

Urban Greening Factor UGF (Landscape).Description: Landscape schedule of UGF, including requirements and proposed values.

Utility Cupboard Schedule.Description: Schedule of utility cupboards. Part of the 0700-0999 Other Schedules series. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-L-A-0704 'Utility Cupboard Schedule'.

Video.Description: Project-related video file (e.g., site video, or meeting recording). Internal video content; store large files appropriately and compress if needed for sharing. Meeting recording does not replace formal minutes

Visualisation Output Images.Description: Rendered image outputs produced from the project's visualisation process. Final still images for presentations; organise these for easy access during meetings or submissions.

Visualisation files export.Description: Exported visualisation files (models or scenes) for use in external applications or sharing.

Visualisation files native.Description: Native visualisation project files (original format scenes) used for creating renders.

Visualisations Output Video.Description: Rendered video output (animated walkthroughs or fly-throughs) from the project's visualisations. Final visualisation videos; use for client presentations and ensure file sizes are manageable for sharing.

Wall Details.Description: External and internal wall junction, section and build-up details. Sub-series range 7600-7649. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-D-A-7600-7649 'Wall Details'.

Wall Finishes Strategy.Description: Wall finishes strategy drawings. Sub-series range 8200-8299 (first document = first number in range +1, e.g. 8201). Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-D-A-8200-8299 'Wall Finishes Strategy'.

Wall Strategy Plans.Description: Wall strategy plans identifying wall types across the building; includes wall setting out plans. As many documents as the project needs within the series. Series range 6100-6199. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-D-A-6100-6199 'Wall Strategy Plans'.

Wardrobe Schedule.Description: Schedule of wardrobes. Part of the 0700-0999 Other Schedules series. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-L-A-0705 'Wardrobe Schedule'.

Window Schedules and Elevations.Description: Window and louvre schedules and elevations. As many documents as the project needs within the series. Series range 0200-0299. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-L-A-0200-0299 'Window Schedules and Elevations'.

Window and Glazed Screen Details.Description: Window and glazed screen head/jamb/sill details. Sub-series range 7550-7599. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-D-A-7550-7599 'Window and Glazed Screen Details'.

Zoning & Circulation Strategy Plans.Description: Zoning and circulation strategy plans. As many documents as the project needs within the series. Series range 6400-6499. Naming and Numbering protocol: ABCDE-BBA-ZZ-ZZ-D-A-6400-6499 'Zoning & Circulation Strategy Plans'.
